name: GIF Speed Changer and Reverser

seo.title: GIF Speed Changer and Reverser — Browser-Local Tool
seo.meta_description: Adjust animated GIF frame delays, optionally reverse frame order and re-encode the result locally.

assumptions: Frame delays are clamped to a safe minimum because some viewers ignore extremely small delays.
limitations: Re-encoding may change palette quantization and file size; timing precision varies by GIF viewer.
